rows.original_target: Every finite prime set gives an edgeless CoHA distinct from P_F.
rows.failure: For F empty, there is only the zero dimension vector and zero representation; the Hall algebra and monoid algebra are both Q.
rows.repair: Restrict the exclusion to nonempty finite F and explicitly state the empty-set calculation. Repeat the nonempty restriction in the closing dependency paragraph.

rows.original_target: If all embedded generator-tower classes are even, PBW is an ordinary polynomial-algebra isomorphism.
rows.failure: Evenness alone places no restriction on the actual Hall commutators. The previously verified tripled-A2 critical CoHA is noncommutative; the existing multiplicative PBW criterion requires pairwise supercommutation.
rows.repair: The conclusion explicitly assumes that the generators supercommute and are all even.
